title: Accusative vs. Instrumental Causees in Causative Constructions

sections.title: When the Base Verb is Intransitive (-t on the Causee)
sections.content: If the underlying verb is intransitive (has no direct object of its own, such as ül 'sits', vitatkozik 'debates', kísérletezik 'experiments', dolgozik 'works'), making it causative turns the performer of the action into the direct object in the accusative (-t): 'A tanár vitatkoztatta a diákokat' (The teacher made the students debate); 'Kármán nem fárasztotta a tanárjelölteket' (Kármán did not tire out the trainee teachers).

sections.title: When the Base Verb is Transitive (-val/-vel on the Causee)
sections.content: By contrast, as soon as the sentence includes a direct object of the action itself (irodalmat olvas, az órát elemzi), the direct object slot (-t) is already occupied. Therefore, the person made to perform the action shifts to the instrumental case (-val/-vel): 'Az apa irodalmat olvastatott a fiúval' (The father had the boy read literature); 'Kármán a tanárjelöltekkel elemeztette a megtartott órákat'.

sections.title: Intransitive Base (Causee in -t) vs. Transitive Base (Causee in -val/-vel)
rows: Az apa irodalmat olvastat a fiúval. (Causee = -val)
Kármán a jelöltekkel elemezteti az órát. (Causee = -vel)

items.spanish: A tanárok vitatkoztatták és kísérleteztették a diákokat az órán.
items.english: The teachers had the students debate and conduct experiments in class.

items.spanish: Kármán Mór a tanárjelöltekkel elemeztette a megtartott órák minden percét.
items.english: Mór Kármán had the trainee teachers analyze every minute of the lessons delivered.

items.spanish: Édesapja inkább történelmet és irodalmat olvastatott a fiatal Tódorral.
items.english: His father had young Theodore read history and literature instead.

sections.title: B2 Usage Notice
sections.content: Notice that lexicalized causative pairs like ül → ültet ('sits → seats') or áll → állít ('stands → sets/places') follow the exact same rule: 'leültette a diákokat a padokba' takes -t because ül is intransitive!
